text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... I can't believe this happened...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for worrying you like this, Trainer... Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No... Snap out of it, Falco! An Umadol's
tears are
reserved only for happy
moments!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine, Trainer! So pick your head up
and turn
that frown upside down!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ouchie!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ouchie!
choice_data_list_en: You can't push yourself like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Agh... I can't believe I made my very first
fan look
so sad...
choice_data_list_en: You can't push yourself like that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol's job is to make her fans
happy, right?
Okay! I'm gonna put all my
effort into healing up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Stay tuned for Falco's miraculous
recovery arc! I'll
be celebrating my
comeback with a concert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon decides to rest and wait
patiently
for her injuries to heal.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uh, Trainer, can we hold up a sec?
choice_data_list: ファル子ならきっと大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My injury might be a lot more serious
than I
thought... Maybe I shouldn't move
around too
much? I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to force a smile for long, Smart
Falcon
takes time off to get some much
needed rest.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely right! I'm not one to
get down
over something like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for believing in me! Consider me
back in
action!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's go! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your encouragement, I've got
tons of
energy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! I just know I can get through it
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon resumes training and
makes an
astonishing recovery!
